title: Big Tech Is Ready to Exploit Garmin’s Clunky Software Problem
content:
24/7 biometrics, ride history and now TrainingPeaks give Garmin an advantage, yet missteps and an AI push from Apple and Google leave the lead far from guaranteed.

Read the full article at Big Tech Is Ready to Exploit Garmin’s Clunky Software Problem on Velo.
author: Josh Ross
